name: Travel Planner by Gildhart
changelog:
• The calendar's month name now opens the next twelve months as a grid: a flight months away is three taps (open the calendar, its month, its day) rather than tapping "next month" over and over.
  • On a phone, the calendar now opens wholly in sight, clear of the booking bar pinned to the foot of the screen.
  • On a phone, the price list keeps its own layout in themes that label every table cell (on Ealing it read "Course £45 a dose"): no theme's labels, nothing past the panel's edge, and each price stays on one line with "a dose".
